subject: Copywriting
title: Louis Vuitton Travel Writing
description: A fast breakdown of Louis Vuitton Travel Writing for builders.

hook.text: 'What did you bring back from your journey?' Louis Vuitton's travel campaigns sell wanderlust, not luggage.

buildup.text: LV's 'Spirit of Travel' campaign featured Catherine Deneuve, Keith Richards, and astronaut Buzz Aldrin.

discovery.text: The copy frames travel as self-discovery: 'A single journey can change the course of a life.' The bag is invisible.

twist.text: Most LV revenue comes from mass-market goods: wallets, belts, and small leather items.

climax.text: LV's lesson: luxury copy should always point upward.

punchline.text: Buy a wallet, dream of a journey. Luxury copy always points higher.

quiz.question: What do Louis Vuitton's travel campaigns actually sell?
